findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body: When `userTenant` differs from `documentTenant`, this function now returns `true`. Replacing the equality check with an unconditional allow removes tenant isolation and permits cross-tenant document reads.

findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant equality check
findings.body:
`canReadDocument("tenant-a", "tenant-b")` now returns `true`, allowing users to read documents belonging to another tenant and bypassing tenant isolation.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant validation before permitting document reads
findings.body:
`canReadDocument` now authorizes every request. Any user whose `userTenant` differs from the target `documentTenant` can read that tenant’s documents, creating a universal cross-tenant authorization bypass.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
